label: TP
reason: Alert 1 ('java/insecure-randomness') is TP because insecure randomness is used to generate 'rememberMeKey' which is then stored in a cookie. Alert 2 ('java/xss') is also TP because user-provided data from cookies is directly concatenated into HTML output without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source (new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)) leads to insecure 'rememberMeKey' generation
User-provided cookie values are directly concatenated into HTML output without encoding, creating XSS vulnerability
